reasoning: Introduce virtual nodes for lighting a row or column. A lit cell can pay1 to enter its own or an adjacent line, and that line reaches initially lit cells on or adjacent to it for free. Adjacent initially lit cells also have zero edges. An unlit destination is reachable only through its exact row/column, not through an adjacent line. Zero-one BFS finds cost with O(n+m+k) edges and respects switching only at initially lit cells.
